description: This file defines the ArrayArgumentProcessor class, which handles processing of array arguments for calculation functions within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages vector and matrix operations, evaluating methods with array inputs for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: ArrayArgumentProcessor
classes.description: A static class responsible for processing array-based arguments and applying mathematical functions element-wise for spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: processArguments
methods.description: Main entry point for processing arguments, handling different array configurations and delegating to appropriate evaluation methods.

methods.name: evaluateVectorMatrixPair
methods.description: Evaluates a pair of vector/matrix arguments, generating a result array based on applying the provided method.

methods.name: evaluateMatrixPair
methods.description: Evaluates a pair of matrices element-wise with the method, producing a matrix of results.

methods.name: evaluateVectorPair
methods.description: Performs element-wise operation on two vectors, returning a nested array as the result.

methods.name: evaluateNthArgumentAsArray
methods.description: Processes the nth argument as an array, applying the method to each element.
